'''''<u>Note</u>''''': You must have a level 2 Permission Level in the world or server to use commands from this mod.  Admins/Operators of a server will automatically be able to use commands.  If cheats are enabled on a world, all players will be able to use commands.

Segments of a command that are enclosed in [brackets/closed parentheses] are not required for a valid command, while segments enclosed in <angle brackets> will invalidate the command if omitted.

== ''[[Evolution Phases]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="phases"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Evolution Phases.

*'''/srpevolution getphase''' - ''Displays current phase and points for the Dimension the Command is used in, if Parasites can gain and/or lose Points in that Dimension, if the point gain is currently on cooldown due to phase change, and the total points needed for the next phase;''
*'''/srpevolution setphase #''' - ''Sets the Dimension's Phase to the specified number (replace '''#''' with anything between -2 and 10);''
*'''/srpevolution addpoints #''' - ''Adds the specified amount of phase points to the Dimension (replace '''#''' with the amount of points you want to add);''
*'''/srpevolution setcooldown #''' - ''Sets a cooldown for point gain (replace '''#''' with the amount of time you want the cooldown to be, in ticks);''
*'''/srpevolution set_evolutiongaining <true:false>''' - ''Toggles if Parasites can gain points in the Dimension the Command is used in;''
*'''/srpevolution set_evolutionloss <true:false>''' - ''Toggles if parasites can lose points in the Dimension the Command is used in;''
*'''/srpevolution evolutionlock_getlist''' - ''Lists all mobs/items currently unable  to evolve;''
*'''/srpevolution evolutionlock_reset''' - ''Clears all evolution locks;''
*'''/srpevolution evolutionlock_unlockall''' - ''Unlocks every evolution lock''.<!--
--><section end="phases"/>


== ''[[Parasite Biome|Biome]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="biome"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to the Parasite Biome, specifically nodes.

*'''/srpnodes clearworld''' - ''Removes all Nodes from the Dimension this Command is used in;''
*'''/srpnodes setnode''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] '''<node tier 0-3>''' - ''Places a Node at the specified coordinates (only works if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4);''
*'''/srpnodes removenode''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] - ''Removes a Node at the specified coordinates, if there is one;''
*'''/srpnodes viewall''' - ''Displays all Node coordinates in the Dimension this Command is used in, along their ages''.<!--
--><section end="biome"/>

== ''[[Harlequin Biome]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="harlequin"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to the Harlequin Biome.

*'''/harlequin_here #''' - ''Converts the surrounding chunks into Harlequin biome and refreshes said chunks (replace '''#''' with the number of chunks you want to generate the biome in);''
*'''/harlequin_convert [radius] [sampleChance] [depth] [blotchChance] [blotchMinDam] [blotchMaxDam]''' - ''Creates circular Harlequin blotches and converts blocks within radius (replace the words in closed parentheses with the desired numbers);''
*'''/harlequin_scatter <rock:bush:tree:ruin:both:all> [tries=#] [radius=#]''' - ''Scatter Harlequin rocks/bushes/trees/ruins on valid surfaces in-biome (replace the words in closed parentheses with the desired numbers)''.<!--
--><section end="harlequin"/>

== ''[[Colony]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="colony"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Colonies.

* '''/srpcolonies clearworld''' - ''Removes all Colonies from the Dimension the Command is used in;''
* '''/srpcolonies setcolony''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] - ''Places a Colony at the specified coordinates (only works if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4);''
* '''/srpcolonies removecolony''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] - ''Removes a Colony at the specified coordinates, if there is one;''
* '''/srpcolonies viewall''' - ''Displays all Colonies coordinates in the Dimension this Command is used in, along their ages;''
* '''/srpcolonies viewallglobaladaptation''' - ''Displays Global [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]] info from Colonies;''
* '''/srpcolonies resetglobaladaptation''' - ''Resets Global Adaptation data''.<!--
--><section end="colony"/>

== ''[[Compendium]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="compendium"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to the Compendium.

* '''/srpguide unlockall''' - ''Unlocks all of the Compendium entries.''
* '''/srpguide unlockblocks''' - ''Unlocks all of the Compendium [[Blocks|Block]] entries.''
* '''/srpguide unlockcelestial''' - ''Unlocks all of the Compendium [[Celestial Events|Celestial Event]] entries.''
* '''/srpguide unlockeffects''' - ''Unlocks all of the Compendium [[:Category:Effects|Effect]] entries.''
* '''/srpguide clearall''' OR '''/srpguideclear''' - ''Locks all of the Compendium entries.''
* '''/srpbestiarystats clear [player]''' OR '''/srpstats clear [player]''' - ''Resets the Stats section of the Compendium for the selected player.''<!--
--><section end="compendium"/>

== ''[[Generations|Generation]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="generations"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Generations.

* '''/srpgeneration addticks #''' - ''Adds # ticks to the current amount;''
* '''/srpgeneration setgeneration #''' - ''Sets the Dimension's Generation to the specified number (replace '''#''' with anything between 0 and 5);''
* '''/srpgeneration getgeneration''' - ''Displays the current Dimension's Generation''.<!--
--><section end="generations"/>

== ''[[Emerging Infestation Vector]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="vector"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to EIVs (Emerging Infestation Vectors).

* '''/srpvectors viewall''' - ''Displays all the current Dimension's Vectors;''
* '''/srpvectors setvector''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] '''<health> <radius>''' - ''Creates/Registers a new EIV at the specified coordinates;''
* '''/srpvectors removevector''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z''']  ''' -''' ''Removes an EIV at the specified coordinates''';'''''
* '''/srpvectors clearworld''' - ''Removes all the EIV's in the current Dimension''.<!--
--><section end="vector"/>

== ''[[Ubiquitous Development]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="ubiquitous"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Ubiquitous Development.

* '''/srpudevelopment getlevel''' - ''Displays the current Ubiquitous Development level;''
* '''/srpudevelopment setlevel #''' - ''Sets the Ubiquitous Development level to the specified number (replace '''#''' with anything between 0 and 4);''
* '''/srpudevelopment viewalldims''' - ''Lists the Evolution Phase, total Evolution points, and Generation by dimension.''
* '''/srpudevelopment setdimevolution <dimension> #''' - ''Sets the specified dimension's Evolution Phase to # (replace <dimension> with the targeted dimension's ID and # with the Phase number).''<!--

== ''[[Dislodgment]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="dislodgment"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Dislodgment.

* '''/srpdislodgment random_code #''' - ''Generates a random Dislodgment value for the specified duration (replace '''#''' with any number);''
* '''/srpdislodgment set_code <ϲ឴឵឵឵឴о឴឵឴d឴឴឴឴឵឴឴е឴឵> <value> <duration_s>''' - ''Manually sets the Dislodgment code and value for the specified duration;''
* '''/srpdislodgment codes_reset''' - ''Clears any current dislodgment code or value''.<!--
--><section end="dislodgment"/>

== ''[[Celestial Events|Celestial Event]] Commands'' ==
<section begin="celestial"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of Commands related to Celestial Events.

* '''/srp_celestial debug''' - ''Displays the current day-night cycle status, active celestial bodies, and forced celestial bodies.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial list''' - ''Lists the IDs of all current sixteen celestial bodies.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial clear''' - ''Voids all current '''forced''' celestial bodies from either /all or /id. Events with 100% chance or are already naturally occurring cannot be cleared unless the Evolution Phase is changed.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial all''' - ''Forces all sixteen celestial bodies to appear at once, regardless of Phase.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial id''' - ''Forces one celestial body regardless of Phase when the respective ID is put in.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial dark_days''' - ''Forces the Dark Days event to occur after eight seconds.'' 
* '''/srp_celestial dark_days_end''' - ''Forces the Dark Days event to end after ten seconds.''<!--
--><section end="celestial"/>

== ''Configuration/Data Commands'' ==
<section begin="config"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of commands that have to do with world data or configuration.

* '''/srparasites readconfigurationfile - ''Reloads the configuration file ingame (NOTE: not all options are working such as Registry or client-side options)''. 
* '''/srparasites getbeckonlimit''' - ''Displays the maximum amount of beckons there can be in one dimension at a time''.
* '''/srparasites setbeckonlimit #''' - ''Changes the maximum amount of beckons there can be in one dimension at a time (replace '''#''' with the number you want to change the limit to)''.
* '''/srparasites resetdatafile''' - ''Resets the world’s <code>srparasites_data.dat</code> data file.  Only do this if parasites are not gaining points, and you’re sure that it’s not point delay.  We generally recommend against doing this''.
* '''/srparasites toggle_dotiledrops''' - ''If set to false, will prevent blocks from dropping when broken by parasites''.
* '''/srparasites toggle_domobevolution''' - ''If set to false, will prevent Parasites from evolving into their next form''.<!--
--><section end="config"/>

== ''Miscellaneous Commands'' ==
<section begin="misc"/><!--
-->Listed below are a series of commands that have nothing to do with any other category.

* '''/srparasites spawnmeteor''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] '''<nowiki><distance></nowiki>''' - ''Activates the [[Meteor]] event (<nowiki><distance></nowiki> determines the distance in blocks the Meteor will land from the central XYZ coordinates).''
* '''/srparasites parasites''' - ''Prints the [[Dislodgment System|Dislodgment Code]], parasite cap, and number of active parasites.''.
* '''/srp_breathe''' - ''Toggles on and off the "breathe" screen distortion effect afflicted by [[Alveolar Fluid]] and [[Dead Blood Fluid]]''.
* '''/srp_summon_nidus''' ['''x'''] ['''y'''] ['''z'''] '''[stage]''' - ''Spawns a certain stage [[Nests#Dispatcher Nests|Dispatcher Nest]] at the specified coordinates. (Replace [stage] with any number 1 - 4, defaults to 1 if entry is missing)''
* '''/srpguidist <on:off:toggle:status> [player:all]''' OR '''/srpguidistortion <on:off:toggle:status> [player:all]''' - ''Enables, disables, toggles, or displays the status of the distortion effect caused by the [[Derived Distortion Phenomenon]] for a certain player or all players.''<!--
--><section end="misc"/>
